svg.title: Province of British Columbia / Conservation Officer cap crest
svg.desc: Clean authored reconstruction: smooth explicit geometry, outlined captions, and named native armorial components. Fine embroidered lettering, exact thread colours and stitch structure are not retained. Outlined type is a source-similar substitute. The rounded compact historical achievement and narrow scalloped border remain distinct from the modern achievement edition.
